48 weeks = 48 × 7 = 336 days.  
336 + 2 = 338 days to add.  
1510 is not a leap year (divisible by 100 but not by 400).  
From 1510-11-19:  
Days remaining in November: 30 − 19 = 11 → 338 − 11 = 327 left.  
December 1510: 31 days → 327 − 31 = 296 left.  
January 1511: 31 → 265 left.  
February 1511: 28 → 237 left.  
March: 31 → 206 left.  
April: 30 → 176 left.  
May: 31 → 145 left.  
June: 30 → 115 left.  
July: 31 → 84 left.  
August: 31 → 53 left.  
September: 30 → 23 left.  
October: 31 → −8 → means date is in October: 31 − 8 = 23.  
FINAL_ANSWER: 1511-10-23
